```{python clean-data}
df = df_raw.with_columns([
    # target
    pl.col("high_booking").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False),
    # price: strip $ and commas
    pl.col("price").str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "").cast(pl.Float64),
    # percent columns
    pl.col("host_response_rate").str.replace("%", "", literal=True).cast(pl.Float64),
    pl.col("host_acceptance_rate").str.replace("%", "", literal=True).cast(pl.Float64),
    # categorical
    pl.col("room_type").cast(pl.Categorical),
    pl.col("property_type").cast(pl.Categorical),
    pl.col("instant_bookable").cast(pl.Categorical),

    pl.when(pl.col("host_response_time") == "N/A")
        .then(None)
        .otherwise(pl.col("host_response_time"))
        .cast(pl.Categorical),
    # numeric
    pl.col("latitude_cleansed").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("longitude_cleansed").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("latitude").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("longitude").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("accommodates").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False),
    pl.col("bathrooms").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("bedrooms").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("beds").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("minimum_nights").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False),
    pl.col("maximum_nights").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False),
    pl.col("reviews_per_month").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    pl.col("host_listings_count").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False),
    pl.col("review_scores_rating").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
```

# feature engineering

```{python regulatory-features}
pat_commercial = r"(?i)hotel|hostel|bed and breakfast|\bresort\b"
pat_primary    = r"(?i)apartment|condominium|condo|\bloft\b|serviced|rental unit|residential|entire home|entire place|\bfloor\b"

def add_regulatory_features(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    prop = pl.col("property_type").cast(pl.Utf8)
    room = pl.col("room_type").cast(pl.Utf8)
    return (
        df
        .with_columns([
            pl.when(
                (room == "Hotel room") |
                prop.str.contains(pat_commercial)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("commercial_type"))
            .when(
                (room == "Entire home/apt") &
                prop.str.contains(pat_primary)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("entire_primary_likely"))
            .when(room == "Entire home/apt")
            .then(pl.lit("entire_nonstandard"))
            .when(room.is_in(["Private room", "Shared room"]))
            .then(pl.lit("room_rental"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("other"))
            .cast(pl.Categorical)
            .alias("regulatory_category"),
        ])
        .with_columns([
            (
                (pl.col("regulatory_category") == "entire_primary_likely") &
                (pl.col("minimum_nights") >= 30)
            ).cast(pl.Int32).alias("min_nights_avoidance_flag"),
        ])
    )

df = add_regulatory_features(df)
print(df["regulatory_category"].value_counts(sort=True))
```

```{python amenities-features}
_LUXURY_KW   = [r"\bpool\b", r"hot tub", r"jacuzzi", r"sauna", r"\bgym\b", r"fitness center",
                r"doorman", r"fireplace", r"piano", r"billiard", r"game room", r"concierge"]
_PRACTICAL_KW = [r"wifi", r"internet", r"wireless", r"kitchen", r"\bwasher\b", r"\bdryer\b",
                 r"\bheating\b", r"air conditioning", r"refrigerator", r"microwave",
                 r"dishwasher", r"\biron\b", r"hair dryer", r"coffee maker"]

def _bucket_count(am_expr, keywords: list) -> pl.Expr:
    flags = [am_expr.str.contains(kw).cast(pl.Int32) for kw in keywords]
    return reduce(lambda a, b: a + b, flags)

def parse_amenities(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    am = pl.col("amenities").fill_null("").str.to_lowercase()
    return df.with_columns([
        _bucket_count(am, _LUXURY_KW).alias("amenity_luxury_count"),
        _bucket_count(am, _PRACTICAL_KW).alias("amenity_practical_count"),
    ])

df = parse_amenities(df)
```

```{python popincourt-specific-features}
# gentrification anchor coordinates
_OBERKAMPF = (48.8667, 2.3667)
_BASTILLE  = (48.8533, 2.3692)
_ROQUETTE  = (48.8567, 2.3790)

def _haversine_m(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:
    R = 6_371_000.0
    phi1, phi2 = math.radians(lat1), math.radians(lat2)
    dphi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlam = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = math.sin(dphi / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(phi1) * math.cos(phi2) * math.sin(dlam / 2) ** 2
    return R * 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1 - a))

def add_haversine_distances(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lats = df["latitude_cleansed"].to_list()
    lons = df["longitude_cleansed"].to_list()
    d_ob  = [_haversine_m(la, lo, *_OBERKAMPF) if la is not None else None for la, lo in zip(lats, lons)]
    d_bas = [_haversine_m(la, lo, *_BASTILLE)  if la is not None else None for la, lo in zip(lats, lons)]
    d_roq = [_haversine_m(la, lo, *_ROQUETTE)  if la is not None else None for la, lo in zip(lats, lons)]
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.Series("distance_to_oberkampf", d_ob,  dtype=pl.Float64),
        pl.Series("distance_to_bastille",  d_bas, dtype=pl.Float64),
        pl.Series("distance_to_roquette",  d_roq, dtype=pl.Float64),
    ])

def add_host_type(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.when(pl.col("host_listings_count") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("casual"))
            .when((pl.col("host_listings_count") >= 2) & (pl.col("host_listings_count") <= 5))
            .then(pl.lit("semi-pro"))
            .when(pl.col("host_listings_count") > 5)
            .then(pl.lit("commercial"))
            .otherwise(None)
            .cast(pl.Categorical)
            .alias("host_type"),
    ])

def add_temporal_features(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("date")
            .str.slice(0, 4)
            .cast(pl.Int32, strict=False)
            .alias("snapshot_year"),
        pl.col("host_since")
            .str.slice(0, 4)
            .cast(pl.Int32, strict=False)
            .alias("cohort_year"),
    ])

def add_min30_flag(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        (pl.col("minimum_nights") >= 30).cast(pl.Int32).alias("min_30_flag"),
    ])

df = add_haversine_distances(df)
df = add_host_type(df)
df = add_temporal_features(df)
df = add_min30_flag(df)

print(df["host_type"].value_counts(sort=True))
print(f"min_30_flag rate: {df['min_30_flag'].mean():.3f}")
```

```{python pricing-features}
def add_dynamic_pricing(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    price = pl.col("price")
    price_tier = (
        pl.when(price < 50).then(pl.lit("budget"))
          .when(price < 100).then(pl.lit("mid"))
          .when(price < 200).then(pl.lit("premium"))
          .otherwise(pl.lit("luxury"))
          .cast(pl.Categorical)
    )
    cleaning_fee_ratio = (
        pl.when(pl.col("cleaning_fee").is_not_null() & (price > 0))
            .then(pl.col("cleaning_fee") / price)
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )
    return df.with_columns([
        price_tier.alias("price_tier"),
        cleaning_fee_ratio.alias("cleaning_fee_ratio"),
        pl.col("price").log(base=math.e).alias("log_price"),
        (pl.col("price") / pl.col("bedrooms").fill_null(1).clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("price_per_bedroom"),
        (pl.col("cleaning_fee").fill_null(0) / pl.col("minimum_nights").clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("cleaning_fee_per_night"),
        (pl.col("price") + pl.col("cleaning_fee").fill_null(0) + pl.col("security_deposit").fill_null(0))
            .alias("total_cost"),
    ])

df = add_dynamic_pricing(df)
```

```{python host-signals}
def host_quality(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        (pl.col("host_listings_count").is_not_null() & (pl.col("host_listings_count") > 1))
            .cast(pl.Int32).alias("is_multi_listing_host"),
        pl.when(pl.col("host_about").is_null())
            .then(0)
            .otherwise(pl.col("host_about").str.split(" ").list.len())
            .cast(pl.Float64).alias("host_experience_proxy"),
    ])

def host_trust_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("host_identity_verified")
            .cast(pl.Utf8).str.to_lowercase().str.contains("true")
            .fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int32).alias("host_identity_verified"),
    ])

def host_verification_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("host_verifications")
            .str.count_matches(r"'[^']+'")
            .fill_null(0).cast(pl.Int32).alias("verification_count"),
    ])

df = host_quality(df)
df = host_trust_signals(df)
df = host_verification_signals(df)
```

```{python imputation}
# reviews_per_month: 0 for listings with no review history
df = df.with_columns(pl.col("reviews_per_month").fill_null(0))

# bedrooms: NA = studio = 0
df = df.with_columns(pl.col("bedrooms").fill_null(0).cast(pl.Int32))

# bathrooms: fill with median
bath_median = df["bathrooms"].median()
df = df.with_columns(pl.col("bathrooms").fill_null(bath_median))

# extra_people, security_deposit, cleaning_fee: fill 0
for col in ["extra_people", "security_deposit", "cleaning_fee"]:
    df = df.with_columns(pl.col(col).fill_null(0))

# has_reviews flag
df = df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("review_scores_rating").is_null()).then(0).otherwise(1)
        .cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_reviews")
)

# host_response_rate
_COMM_IMPUTE = {0: 90.0, 1: 95.0, 2: 96.0}

review_sub_cols = [
    "review_scores_cleanliness", "review_scores_checkin",
    "review_scores_communication", "review_scores_location", "review_scores_value"
]

def cat_review_expr(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when((pl.col("has_reviews") == 0) | pl.col(col_name).is_null())
            .then(0)
            .when(pl.col(col_name) < 10)
            .then(1)
            .otherwise(2)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias(col_name)
    )

df = df.with_columns([cat_review_expr(c) for c in review_sub_cols])

df = df.with_columns([
    pl.col("host_response_rate").is_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("host_response_rate_missing"),
    pl.when(pl.col("host_response_rate").is_not_null())
        .then(pl.col("host_response_rate"))
        .when(pl.col("review_scores_communication") == 0).then(pl.lit(90.0))
        .when(pl.col("review_scores_communication") == 1).then(pl.lit(95.0))
        .otherwise(pl.lit(96.0))
        .alias("host_response_rate"),
])

df = df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("host_response_rate") >= 100).then(pl.lit("perfect"))
        .when(pl.col("host_response_rate") >= 90).then(pl.lit("near_perfect"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("underperforming"))
        .cast(pl.Categorical).alias("host_response_tier")
)

# host_acceptance_rate
_ACC_OTHER_MEAN = 84.3
df = df.with_columns([
    pl.col("host_acceptance_rate").is_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("host_acceptance_rate_missing"),
    pl.when(pl.col("host_acceptance_rate").is_not_null())
        .then(pl.col("host_acceptance_rate"))
        .when(pl.col("instant_bookable").cast(pl.Utf8).str.to_lowercase().str.contains("t"))
        .then(pl.lit(100.0))
        .otherwise(pl.lit(_ACC_OTHER_MEAN))
        .alias("host_acceptance_rate"),
])

print("Imputation complete")
print(df.select(["reviews_per_month", "bathrooms", "host_response_rate", "host_acceptance_rate"])
        .null_count())
```

# model preparation

```{python select-features}
tabular_features = [
    # price signals
    "log_price", "price_tier", "cleaning_fee_ratio", "price_per_bedroom",
    "cleaning_fee_per_night", "total_cost",
    # host identity
    "host_type", "host_listings_count", "is_multi_listing_host",
    "host_experience_proxy", "host_identity_verified", "verification_count",
    "host_response_rate", "host_response_rate_missing", "host_response_tier",
    "host_acceptance_rate", "host_acceptance_rate_missing",
    # listing characteristics
    "room_type", "regulatory_category", "accommodates", "bedrooms", "bathrooms",
    "amenity_count", "amenity_luxury_count", "amenity_practical_count",
    # booking policy
    "instant_bookable", "cancellation_policy", "minimum_nights", "min_30_flag",
    "min_nights_avoidance_flag",
    # review signals
    "reviews_per_month", "review_scores_rating", "review_scores_cleanliness",
    "review_scores_communication", "review_scores_location", "review_scores_value",
    "has_reviews",
    # geography
    "latitude_cleansed", "longitude_cleansed",
    "distance_to_oberkampf", "distance_to_bastille", "distance_to_roquette",
    # temporal
    "snapshot_year", "cohort_year",
]

cat_features = [
    "host_type", "room_type", "regulatory_category", "price_tier",
    "instant_bookable", "cancellation_policy", "host_response_tier",
]

df_model = df.select(tabular_features + ["high_booking"]).to_pandas()

# fill categoricals
for col in cat_features:
    df_model[col] = df_model[col].astype(object).fillna("Unknown")

# drop rows with null target
df_model = df_model.dropna(subset=["high_booking"])

y = df_model["high_booking"].astype(int).values
X = df_model.drop(columns=["high_booking"])

print(f"Feature matrix: {X.shape}")
print(f"Positive rate: {y.mean():.3f}")
print("Null counts per feature:")
print(X.isnull().sum()[X.isnull().sum() > 0])
```

```{python train-test-split}
X_train, X_holdout, y_train, y_holdout = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

print(f"Train: {X_train.shape[0]} | Holdout: {X_holdout.shape[0]}")
print(f"Train positive rate: {y_train.mean():.3f} | Holdout positive rate: {y_holdout.mean():.3f}")
```

# model training

```{python catboost-fit}
best_params = {
    "learning_rate":    0.02,
    "depth":            9,
    "l2_leaf_reg":      35,
    "subsample":        0.7471,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 226,
    "rsm":              0.6177,
    "random_strength":  0.80,
}

final_params = {
    "loss_function":      "Logloss",
    "eval_metric":        "AUC",
    "auto_class_weights": "Balanced",
    "iterations":         2000,
    "od_wait":            25,
    "logging_level":      "Verbose",
    "random_seed":        42,
    **best_params,
}

train_pool   = cb.Pool(X_train,   label=y_train,   cat_features=cat_features)
holdout_pool = cb.Pool(X_holdout, label=y_holdout, cat_features=cat_features)

model = CatBoostClassifier(**final_params)
model.fit(train_pool, eval_set=holdout_pool, use_best_model=True)

print(f"\nBest iteration: {model.best_iteration_}")
```

# evaluation

```{python evaluation}
holdout_proba = model.predict_proba(holdout_pool)[:, 1]
holdout_pred  = (holdout_proba >= 0.5).astype(int)

auc = roc_auc_score(y_holdout, holdout_proba)
print(f"Holdout ROC AUC:  {auc:.5f}")
print(f"US Kaggle AUC:    0.86071  (Part I national baseline)")
print(f"\nClassification report (threshold = 0.50):")
print(classification_report(y_holdout, holdout_pred, target_names=["low_booking", "high_booking"]))
```

```{python threshold-sweep}
thresholds = np.arange(0.20, 0.80, 0.02)
results = []
for t in thresholds:
    pred_t = (holdout_proba >= t).astype(int)
    report = classification_report(y_holdout, pred_t, output_dict=True, zero_division=0)
    results.append({
        "threshold": round(t, 2),
        "precision_high": round(report["1"]["precision"], 3),
        "recall_high":    round(report["1"]["recall"],    3),
        "f1_high":        round(report["1"]["f1-score"],  3),
    })

thresh_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
best_f1_row = thresh_df.loc[thresh_df["f1_high"].idxmax()]
print(thresh_df.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nOptimal threshold (max F1 on high_booking): {best_f1_row['threshold']}")
```

# SHAP analysis

```{python shap-global}
shap_vals = model.get_feature_importance(
    holdout_pool,
    type="ShapValues"
)
shap_matrix = shap_vals[:, :-1]  # drop bias column
shap_df     = pd.DataFrame(shap_matrix, columns=X_holdout.columns)

# global bar: mean |SHAP| per feature
shap_importance = shap_df.abs().mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
shap_direction  = shap_df.mean().reindex(shap_importance.index)

print("=== Global SHAP Importance (mean |SHAP|) ===")
print(pd.DataFrame({
    "mean_abs_shap": shap_importance.round(4),
    "mean_shap_direction": shap_direction.round(4)
}).to_string())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 10))
shap_importance.head(20).sort_values().plot.barh(ax=ax, color="steelblue")
ax.set_title("Top 20 Features - Mean |SHAP| (Popincourt Model)")
ax.set_xlabel("Mean |SHAP value|")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python shap-beeswarm}
# reuse shap_matrix from shap-global - avoids TreeExplainer categorical column issue
_base_value = float(shap_vals[0, -1])

shap_explanation = shap.Explanation(
    values=shap_matrix,
    base_values=np.full(len(shap_matrix), _base_value),
    data=X_holdout.values,
    feature_names=X_holdout.columns.tolist(),
)

shap.plots.beeswarm(shap_explanation, max_display=20, show=True)
```

```{python shap-individual-profiles}
_base_value = float(shap_vals[0, -1])
_feat_names  = X_holdout.columns.tolist()

# best case: casual + budget - use positional index into shap_matrix
best_pos = np.where(
    (X_holdout["host_type"].values == "casual") &
    (X_holdout["price_tier"].values == "budget")
)[0]
if len(best_pos) > 0:
    p = best_pos[np.argmax(holdout_proba[best_pos])]  # highest predicted prob in segment
    print(f"=== Best Case: Casual + Budget (highest predicted probability in segment) ===")
    print(f"Predicted probability: {holdout_proba[p]:.3f}")
    print(f"Actual label: {y_holdout[p]}")
    shap.plots.waterfall(shap.Explanation(
        values=shap_matrix[p],
        base_values=_base_value,
        data=X_holdout.iloc[p].values,
        feature_names=_feat_names,
    ), max_display=15, show=True)

# worst case: commercial + premium
worst_pos = np.where(
    (X_holdout["host_type"].values == "commercial") &
    (X_holdout["price_tier"].values == "premium")
)[0]
if len(worst_pos) > 0:
    p = worst_pos[np.argmin(holdout_proba[worst_pos])]  # lowest predicted prob in segment
    print(f"\n=== Worst Case: Commercial + Premium (lowest predicted probability in segment) ===")
    print(f"Predicted probability: {holdout_proba[p]:.3f}")
    print(f"Actual label: {y_holdout[p]}")
    shap.plots.waterfall(shap.Explanation(
        values=shap_matrix[p],
        base_values=_base_value,
        data=X_holdout.iloc[p].values,
        feature_names=_feat_names,
    ), max_display=15, show=True)
```

# comparison: Popincourt vs US national model

```{python model-comparison}
print("=" * 55)
print("Model Comparison")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"US National CatBoost (Kaggle AUC):  0.86071")
print(f"Popincourt CatBoost (holdout AUC):  {auc:.5f}")
print()
print("Top 10 features by SHAP (Popincourt):")
for i, (feat, val) in enumerate(shap_importance.head(10).items(), 1):
    direction = "↑" if shap_direction[feat] > 0 else "↓"
    print(f"  {i:2}. {feat:<35} {val:.4f}  {direction}")
print()
print("Key interpretation:")
```
